props.body: From AI-powered scheduling to automated meeting recaps and follow-ups, get the busywork done with fewer tools and less effort.

props.body: Join 20 million professionals who easily book meetings with the #1 scheduling tool.

props.title: Built for people whose work runs on meetings
props.body: Meetings move you forward, but the work around them can slow you down. Calendly handles the tasks before, during, and after meetings, so you have more space for what matters.

cards.heading: Book
cards.restingDescription: Book the meeting and get paid with zero back-and-forth.

children.text: A client emails asking to meet. Share a booking link or ask Callie, your AI assistant, to find times that work for everyone.

items.text: Callie replies with times to meet

cards.heading: Prep
cards.restingDescription: Never walk into a meeting cold.

children.text: Before the meeting, get all of the info you need in one place. Callie reviews your client's contact history and helps you show up prepared.

items.text: Your client interactions are in one place

cards.heading: Capture
cards.restingDescription: Focus on the conversation. Notetaker handles the notes.

children.text: While you run the meeting, Notetaker captures the conversation. The recap and action items are delivered right after the call.

items.text: Recap is stored in contact profile

cards.heading: Follow up
cards.restingDescription: Work moves forward after the meeting ends.

children.text: Review a pre-drafted email based on the recap, add an additional invoice link if needed, and add Callie to the email to handle scheduling.

items.text: Callie finds time for the next call

props.title: There’s more to meetings than finding a time.
props.body: Book meetings, capture discussions and decisions, and keep next steps moving with tools that help you handle the work before, during, and after every meeting.

props.heading: A better way to book your meetings

items.title: Full control over your calendar
items.description: Connect your calendars, set your hours, and control exactly when you're available to meet.

items.title: Meeting templates for every scenario
items.description: From one-on-one calls to multi-host meetings, pre-built event types make scheduling easy for everyone.

items.title: Automated email & text workflows
items.description: Reduce no-shows with personalized email and text reminders, and let invitees reschedule when needed without the back-and-forth.

items.title: Website embeds and routing forms
items.description: Let visitors schedule right from your website. Add routing forms to qualify leads and match them with the right team member.

items.title: Scheduling whenever, wherever
items.description: Access Calendly from the mobile app or browser extension, or use it with your favorite AI tool, LinkedIn, or 150+ other integrations.

items.title: Tools for teams of all sizes
items.description: Grow your business with scheduling that scales. Add teammates, set permissions, and manage access without switching tools.

props.location: [Home] - Accordion Switchback - Scheduling - A better way to book meetings

items.title: Conversational scheduling
items.description: Instead of managing scheduling links and calendars yourself, just add callie@calendly.com to the email thread. Say what you need and let Callie take it from there.

items.title: Precise coordination
items.description: Callie runs on your Calendly availability preferences, weighs conflicts and constraints, and always checks with you before making one-off updates.

items.title: 24/7 assistance with meeting tasks
items.description: In Calendly, ask Callie for help with scheduling, meeting prep, recalling conversation and contact details, and more.

items.title: Clear summaries with next steps
items.description: End every call with meeting summaries and next steps, so nothing falls through the cracks.

items.title: Pre-drafted follow-up emails
items.description: Follow up faster with a ready-to-share recap and action items. Password-protect recaps or auto-share with attendees.

items.title: Works with your tools
items.description: Add Notetaker to Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams meetings — even ones booked outside Calendly. Sync recaps to your CRM.

items.title: Instant meeting recall
items.description: See a contact's full meeting history in one place. Ask Callie about any recap and get answers instantly.

items.title: Upfront meeting payments
items.description: Collect payment when clients book with you, so you can get paid sooner and reduce no-shows.

items.title: Meeting packages
items.description: Sell multi-session bundles clients can purchase once and schedule over time — ideal for ongoing client work like coaching and consulting.

items.title: Invoices
items.description: Send professional branded invoices for post-meeting billing, installments, or project-based work, with built-in tracking and reminders.

items.title: Payment links
items.description: Share payment links to quickly request payment for anything, anytime — from one-off services to follow-up fees.
